name: Kevin Moore
why: 1993 Talisman senior portrait grid, p. 41. The grid is four portraits across and five rows deep; each row's four names, majors and hometowns are printed in order in the column to the right of the grid. The second row's names read Paulette Monroe, Kevin Moore, Alison L. Moorman, Chris Morehead, and this is the second cell of that row. He is the only Kevin Moore in the 1993 index, which gives him p. 41. A clean studio headshot, in focus, facing the camera; small only because the TopSCHOLAR scan is about 96 dpi, 864 pixels to a printed page.

name: Mary Susan Bunce
why: 1991 Talisman senior portrait grid, p. 88. Four portraits across, five rows deep, with each row's four names, majors and hometowns printed in order in the column to the left. The fourth row reads John A. Buckingham, John A. Burden, Mary S. Bunce, Shannon M. Bunnell, and this is the third cell of that row; the first two cells are men and the last two women, which agrees with the list. She is the only Bunce anywhere in the volume, and the same volume's organization captions on pp. 184-185 print her as Mary Susan Bunce three times, in Kappa Delta, the Inter-Organizational Council and Leadership. A clean studio headshot, in focus, facing the camera; small only because the TopSCHOLAR scan is about 96 dpi.
caption_quote: Mary S. Bunce, Corp. Comm., Louisville
id_note: The archive also carries a 'Mary Sue Bunce' at 1990-91, almost certainly the same woman, but the two entries are not merged here. Filed to the spelling the Talisman itself uses.

name: Kelly Elliott
why: 1991 Talisman sophomore portrait grid, printed p. 115, running head Cam-Elr. The grid is five portraits across and six rows deep; the names are printed in the outer column in six groups of five, one group per row, in left-to-right order. The sixth group reads R. Teresa Edmundson, Cheryl A. Edwards, Melissa L. Edwards, Kelly J. Elliott, Marcy R. Elrod, and this is the fourth cell of the sixth row. She is the only Elliott on the page and the only Kelly Elliott in the volume's sophomore run. A clean studio headshot, in focus, facing the camera; small only because the TopSCHOLAR scan is about 96 dpi, 880 pixels to a printed page.
id_note: The archive also carries a 'Kelly Elliot' at 1989-90 and the 1992 Talisman underclassmen grid prints a 'Kelly Elliot (Soph.), Bowling Green'. The two are not merged here: this portrait is filed only to the 1990-91 Kelly Elliott, whose spelling the 1991 Talisman matches exactly and whose year the volume covers.

name: Amanda Button
why: 1992 Talisman senior portrait grid, printed p. 94 (PDF spread 50, left page; folio reads '94 Classes'). The grid is four portraits across; each row's four names, majors and hometowns are printed in order in the column to the left of the grid. Row one reads Roger D. Burns II, Amanda K. Button, Sheryl L. Callecod, Thomasine Campbell, and the four cells are man, woman, woman, woman in that order, so she is the second cell. The volume's index confirms the whole row on the one page: 'Burns II, Roger D. 94', 'Button, Amanda K. 94', 'Callecod, Sheryl L. 94, 162', 'Campbell, Thomasine 94'. She is the only Button in the 1992 index and there is no Button in the 1990, 1991 or 1993 volumes. A clean studio headshot, in focus, facing the camera; small only because the TopSCHOLAR scan is about 96 dpi, 880 pixels to a printed page.
caption_quote: Amanda K. Button, Advertising, Bowling Green

name: Daryl Pepper
why: 1992 Talisman, p. 19, bottom-right photograph of the 1991 Homecoming court on the Smith Stadium track, credited to Mark T. Osler. Only two people stand in the frame, a man in a light suit and a woman on his arm, and the caption beside it names exactly two, Daryl Pepper escorting Lee Ann Walke, so the man is Pepper. Indexed 'Pepper, Daryl 19' and he is the only Pepper of that name in the volume. His only photograph anywhere in the 1988-1993 volumes: he has no class-portrait page. Soft and small because the scan is about 96 dpi and this is a night exposure cropped out of a wider frame, but the face is legible and the frame is a dignified one.
caption_quote: Daryl Pepper, an Elizabethtown senior, escorted Lee Ann Walke

name: Dawn Bradley
why: 1990 Talisman, p. 109, underclassmen portrait grid, running head 'A - Bri'. The grid is six portraits across and eight rows deep, forty-eight cells, and the names are printed in the outer column in eight groups of exactly six, one group per row, left to right. The eighth group reads Dawn Bradley, Carrie Bragg, Sheryl Brewer, Tanya Bricking, Henry D. Brierly, Robin Bristoe, and this is the first cell of the eighth row. The mapping checks against the sexes: row one reads man, man, woman, woman, woman, man for Chris Adams, Tim Adcox, Tabitha Aldridge, Amanda Alexander, Sandra Alford, Danny C. Allen, and the pictures agree, as they do in row six and row eight. She is the only Bradley on the page and the page covers the whole of A to Bri. A clean studio headshot, in focus, facing the camera; small only because the scan is about 96 dpi.

name: Eric Elliott
why: 1990 Talisman, p. 112, underclassmen portrait grid, running head 'Ebe - Fut'. Six portraits across; the names are printed in the outer column in groups of six, one group per row, left to right. The first group reads Gena Eberhard, Angelo Edwards, Eric Elliott, Kelly Elliott, Marcy Elrod, Lisa Embry, and this is the third cell of the first row. The mapping checks against the sexes across all three full rows: row one is woman, man, man, woman, woman, woman and the pictures agree, as do row two (woman, man, man, woman, woman, woman) and row three (woman, woman, woman, man, man, woman). He is the only Eric Elliott in the volume and the page covers Ebe to Fut. A clean studio headshot in coat and tie, in focus, facing the camera; small only because the scan is about 96 dpi.
id_note: The archive carries 'Eric Elliott' at 1988-89 and 'Eric Elliot' at 1989-90 as two entries. The 1990 Talisman knows one Eric Elliott, a junior from Somerset, and this portrait is filed only to the entry whose spelling the Talisman matches exactly. The two entries are not merged here.
